4: O God, hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth.
5: For strangers have risen up against me, and mighty men have sought my life: they have not set God before them. Pause.
6: For behold! God assists me; and the Lord is the helper of my soul.
7: He shall return evil to my enemies; utterly destroy them in your truth.
8: I will willingly sacrifice to you: I will give thanks to your name, O Lord; for [it is] good.
9: For you have delivered me out of all affliction, and my eye has seen [my desire] upon my enemies.
